motor_note: All 20 limb and wheel modules are MG5010E-i36-V3 (confirmed 2026-09-21); both grippers are DM4310.
gripper_mass_note: Each DM4310 motor is 300 g; each mechanism uses the arm's 160 g estimate.
unknown_mass_note: The torso/battery board and wheels use solid-PLA-density geometry estimates until weighed. Set their masses above when known.
notes: Motor CAD is MG4010 geometry used as a placeholder for the MG5010; packaging and mass distribution are unverified.
The 25 N m peak torque is not used. Friction, backlash, thermal limits, torque-speed curves and real controller gains are uncalibrated.
Rotary joints keep continuous CAD travel; viewer slider ranges are not mechanical joint limits.
